bundle.shortDescription: Non-custodial wallet for the Radiant (RXD) blockchain
bundle.longDescription: Lumen RXD Wallet is a non-custodial desktop wallet for the Radiant (RXD) blockchain: HD wallets (m/44'/512'), live balances via ElectrumX, WAVE name resolution, and Glyph token support.
